findings.summary: The text says OrderPlaced fans out to payment, but payment happens before the order is PLACED, and the page's own diagram does not send it to payment.
findings.evidence: "`OrderPlaced` fans out to payment, restaurant, dispatch, notification". The state machine on page 7 has PAYMENT_PENDING → PLACED on "paid". The diagram shows order→pay as "sync gRPC" and Kafka → rest, disp, notif, stats only.
findings.fix: Change to: "`OrderPlaced` (published after payment succeeds) fans out to restaurant, dispatch, notification and analytics; payment is called synchronously before it."

findings.summary: The architecture says OrderPlaced fans out to the payment service, but payment must complete before an order is PLACED, so the event order is circular.
findings.evidence: Diagram edges "order -> pay: sync gRPC" and "order -> kafka: OrderPlaced", "kafka -> rest/disp/notif/stats", plus the text "`OrderPlaced` fans out to payment, restaurant, dispatch, notification". Page 7 has "PAYMENT_PENDING -> PLACED: paid".
findings.fix: Remove payment from the OrderPlaced fan-out. State that payment is called synchronously first, and that OrderPlaced is published only after payment succeeds. Fix the same Kafka-to-payment edge on page 7.
